name: Elementalist
role: Elementalists are magical warriors, wielding elemental damage with the same skill and tactical precision a fighter might wield their sword or bow

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.description: An elementalist is proficient with all martial and simple weapons and light armor.

features.name: Casting
features.description: An elementalist may combine spheres and talents to create magical effects. An elementalist is considered a Mid-Caster. (Note: All casters gain 2 bonus talents and a casting tradition the first time they gain the casting class feature.)

features.name: Spell Pool
features.description: An elementalist gains a small reservoir of energy he can call on to create truly wondrous effects, called a spell pool. This pool contains a number of spell points equal to his class level + his casting ability modifier (minimum 1). This pool replenishes once per day after roughly 8 hours of rest.

features.name: Magic Talents
features.description: An elementalist gains 3/4ths of a magic talent per level, according to Table: The Elementalist.

features.name: Weave Energy
features.description: An elementalist gains the Destruction sphere as a bonus magic talent and uses his class level as his caster level with the Destruction sphere. This stacks normally with caster levels gained from other sources.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: At 2nd level an elementalist learns to avoid damage from many area-effect attacks. If an elementalist succeeds at a Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, he instead takes no damage. Evasion can be used only if the elementalist is wearing light armor or no armor and carrying no more than a light load. A helpless elementalist does not gain the benefit of evasion.

features.name: Combat Feat
features.description: An elementalist's martial focus grants him a bonus combat feat at 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter, chosen from those for which he qualifies.

features.name: Favored Element
features.description:
At 3rd level, the elementalist chooses one blast type group from the Destruction sphere. When creating a destructive blast from this blast type group, it deals an additional +1/2 damage per elementalist level.

At 9th and 15th level, the elementalist chooses an additional favored element, gaining the same bonus. In addition, the bonus granted by his previous favored elements increase by an additional +1/2 damage per elementalist level.

features.name: Dodge Bonus
features.description: At 4th level, an elementalist gains a +1 dodge bonus to his AC. This increases by one for every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

features.name: Elemental Defense
features.description: At 5th level, an elementalist gains resistance 5 to acid, cold, fire, and electricity. At 11th level, this resistance increases to 10. At 17th level, this resistance increases to 15.

features.name: Elemental Movement
features.description: At 7th level, the elementalist gains one of the following: a 30 feet swim speed, a 20 feet fly speed with maneuverability (average), a 15 feet burrow speed, or a +20 feet bonus to his base speed. At 13th and 19th levels, the elementalist gains an additional elemental movement and all elemental movements possessed increase by 10 feet.

features.name: Improved Evasion
features.description: At 11th level, an elementalist's evasion ability improves. He still takes no damage on a successful Reflex saving throw against attacks, but henceforth he takes only half damage on a failed save. A helpless elementalist does not gain the benefit of improved evasion.

features.name: Energy Body
features.description: At 20th level, the elementalist's body has become one with the energy he weaves. His elemental defense increases to resistance 20, and he gains immunity to sneak attacks and critical hits, and gains DR 10/magic.

archetypes.name: Admixture Savant
archetypes.summary: Admixture savants specialize in mixing blast types together to create more potent blasts.

archetypes.name: Arcanophage
archetypes.summary: The Arcanophage specializes in mimicking the powers they've seen - but the more they imitate, the higher the chance of triggering Wild Magic becomes!

archetypes.name: Arcanopulser [CS]
archetypes.summary: The Arcanopulser is a Champion that can use the Mana sphere to create pulsating shots of power.

archetypes.name: Earth Warrior
archetypes.summary: Earth warriors specialize in manipulating the earth for offense, defense, and movement.

archetypes.name: Electrokinetic
archetypes.summary: Electrokinetics master electric blasts to hurl lightning at their foes.

archetypes.name: Elemontalist
archetypes.summary: Elemontalists are proud warriors of the citric arts, drawing powerful and refreshing might from the most powerful of scurvy deterrents.

archetypes.name: Flame Warrior
archetypes.summary: Flame warriors are experts at manipulating fire to serve their purposes.

archetypes.name: Geomancer
archetypes.summary: Geomancers trade their mastery of destruction for control over the Nature sphere.

archetypes.name: Martial Elementalist [CS]
archetypes.summary: Martial elementalists are capable of using the combat spheres.

archetypes.name: Metal Warrior
archetypes.summary: Metal warriors can conduct electrical power through their bodies to shock their foes.

archetypes.name: Natural Warrior
archetypes.summary: Natural warriors manipulate chemical acids and are at home in natural environments.

archetypes.name: Sablesavant [DRS]
archetypes.summary: Sablesavants mix and swirl their destructive magics with cloying darkness. This archetype uses the Polished Dark sphere rework.

archetypes.name: Soul Adept
archetypes.summary: Soul adepts focus on etheric energies and manipulate the powers of Death.

archetypes.name: Tenebrous Stalker
archetypes.summary: Tenebrous stalkers are elementalists who specialize in Dark and Illusion.

archetypes.name: Twinsoul Elementalist
archetypes.summary: Twinsoul elementalists create elemental conduits that act as companions.

archetypes.name: Water Warrior
archetypes.summary: Water warriors can manipulate water well and are resistant to damage from the cold.

archetypes.name: Wind Warrior
archetypes.summary: Wind warriors shape the air to strike at their foes and shield their bodies.
